PROFILE
Primary school teacher with three years of classroom experience across Foundation
to Year 3 in Victorian Catholic and government schools. Strong focus on early
literacy: explicit, systematic synthetic phonics, decodable texts, small-group
reading intervention and data-informed planning. Calm, structured classroom
manager who builds warm relationships with students and families. Fully
registered with the Victorian Institute of Teaching and looking for an ongoing
primary classroom role in Melbourne.
